crossRefs.note: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.
On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ochran, prince of the children of Asher,

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Pagiel
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Asher

translations.web: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.
translations.bsb: Pagiel son of Ocran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,
translations.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
